Introduction

PRELUDE is an upcoming four-member global girl group under HYBE Labels and Geffen Records in collaboration with ANEMA. They will launch a survival show project to find the fourth member of the group in Japan.

Between August 25-27, they revealed the first three confirmed members of the group: former The Debut: Dream Academy contestants Emily Kelavos, Samara Siqueira, and Lexie Levin.
